description: R08 Host VT I/O checkpoint: close SetConsoleActiveScreenBuffer through the existing safe-Rust screen snapshot serializer and a direct Microsoft 8x4 screen-state vector.

entries.notes: The safe-Rust vt_screen_dump owner reproduces Microsoft's complete observable when returning to the main buffer: ASB reset, all four 8-column rows with exact legacy color transitions, cursor position, default attributes, cursor visibility, and autowrap state. Native screen-buffer handle selection remains the platform input to the snapshot serializer rather than deferred output behavior.
